search.snippet: Steel kiteshield (g) is a part of steel gold-trimmed armour and a reward from easy Treasure Trails. It has the same stats as a normal steel kiteshield, except for the ranged attack bonus (-2 rather than -3), and requires level 5 Defence to wear. This item cannot be made via the Smithing skill.
